stocks:MSFT.recent: Outlook and Teams went down for nearly a day, Downdetector logged 130,000 Outlook reports at the peak, and the shares fell 3% as the disruption spread. The same fortnight brought two Windows flaws: Kaspersky's BlackX bootkit beat Secure Boot on fully patched machines, and SignDrop handed ordinary users System rights.

poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Israel-Iran ceasefire is still holding on 31 December. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it moves on every strike, threat and report of talks.
poly-israel-x-iran-ceasefire-continues-t.recent: Iran's Guard says mines hit tankers on the southern route through the Strait of Hormuz, 4 in 24 hours by its count, as a third US carrier reached the Persian Gulf. At talks in Islamabad, Iran cut its Hormuz reopening plan from 7 days to 2.

wiki-nvidia.standing: Nvidia, the Santa Clara chip designer whose graphics processors run most of the world's AI training, and one of the most valuable companies on earth. Its fortunes carry the chip sector and the data-centre build-out with them.
wiki-nvidia.recent: Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia's chief executive amid a US-China spy scandal over his ties to Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive in Singapore, and Colette Kress, finance chief since 2013, took over. Days later Trump backed his return, and 177,000 people signed a petition to reinstate him.

poly-will-anthropic-ipo-on-november-19-2.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab that makes Claude, lists its shares publicly on November 19, 2026. A listing would put a public market price on one of the leading AI developers for the first time.

wiki-petroleum.standing: Crude oil and the fuels refined from it: petrol, diesel, jet fuel and the feedstock for plastics. It supplies about a third of the world's energy, and its price runs through transport, food and inflation almost everywhere.
wiki-petroleum.recent: Houthi missiles fired at Riyadh blew out windows across Aramco Tower, and Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline was struck a day later. Brent still fell below $90 for the first time since August, as Saudi output rose 26% in October. It jumped back to $94.30 minutes after a Trump post on Iran.

poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the US House of Representatives impeaches Pete Hegseth, the defense secretary, before 2028. Impeachment takes only a simple House majority, so the price lives on who controls the chamber.
poly-will-pete-hegseth-be-the-first-of-t.recent: Nothing reported in the fortnight concerns Hegseth or an impeachment, and none of it accounts for the price. The prediction-market news was about the markets themselves: Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into its rival, Polymarket.

poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Iran and Oman, the two states on either shore of the Strait of Hormuz, reach an agreement on the strait by November 30. The price is what traders pay for a yes.
poly-iran-oman-hormuz-agreement-by-novem.recent: Iran's Hormuz diplomacy went through Islamabad, not Oman: there it shortened its plan to reopen the strait from 7 days to 2. Iran says mines hit 4 tankers in 24 hours in a zone east of the strait that it declared off-limits, and a third US carrier reached the Gulf, putting 3 carriers and 13 destroyers opposite Iran.

stocks:TMUS.standing: One of the three national mobile carriers in the United States, majority-owned by Deutsche Telekom since it absorbed Sprint in 2020. Its subscriber fight with Verizon and AT&T carries much of the German parent's value.
stocks:TMUS.recent: New York accused T-Mobile of throttling the internet service it sells to low-income households to 600 Kbps. A state charge against its own business is a cost, not a lift, and nothing else in the input accounts for the share climbing to its high the same day.

stocks:UAL.standing: The parent of United Airlines, one of the three largest US carriers, with hubs in Chicago, Newark and San Francisco. Its shares move on jet fuel costs, business-travel demand and its transatlantic and Pacific routes.
stocks:UAL.recent: United's own news this fortnight was operational rather than financial: it barred AI agents such as OpenAI's dots from booking its flights, and on Monday a system outage stalled its departures for 90 minutes. Neither accounts for the climb in the share price.

stocks:LUV.standing: The share price of Southwest Airlines, the largest US domestic carrier by passengers, built on a single Boeing 737 fleet and point-to-point routes. It moves with jet fuel costs and with how full planes on US routes are.

wiki-bitcoin.standing: Daily readers of Wikipedia's article on bitcoin, the first cryptocurrency: a digital currency with no central issuer, launched in 2009. Surges mark the moments the coin reaches people outside the trading world.
wiki-bitcoin.recent: The CLARITY Act stalled 49 to 50 in the Senate, and a slide followed. Spot bitcoin ETFs lost a net $1.282 billion in a week, MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes, and $1.3 billion of futures were liquidated as the price fell below $70,000 and then briefly below $62,000.

stocks:BIDU.standing: China's largest search engine, whose New York-listed shares also price its bets on Ernie AI models, Kunlun chips and Apollo Go robotaxis.
stocks:BIDU.recent: The news about Baidu this fortnight was product news: a 1,024-chip Tianchi supernode it will sell next year, and a simulator that stands in for some of the 700,000km of road testing each robotaxi model iteration needs. Neither accounts for the share price.

stocks:MSTR.standing: The former MicroStrategy, a business-software firm that became the largest listed holder of bitcoin, buying it by selling its own shares and debt. Its stock trades as a leveraged bet on the coin.
stocks:MSTR.recent: Bitcoin fell below $76K as an AI stock rout hit Strategy, Coinbase and Circle, taking the value of its 850,364 bitcoin down with it. MSCI then ruled that a company whose business is buying bitcoin is a fund and confirmed it will drop it from its indexes. Index funds must sell, and a model that sells shares and debt to buy more bitcoin loses its passive buyers.

stocks:MSCI.standing: The New York-listed firm behind the MSCI World and Emerging Markets indexes, which it licenses to fund managers with risk analytics and ESG ratings. Its fees scale with the money tracking those indexes.
stocks:MSCI.recent: The one story about the company's own business came after this window closed: on 12 November MSCI dropped Strategy, owner of 850,364 bitcoin, from its indexes, putting that firm's bitcoin-buying model on the line. Nothing in the input accounts for the share's earlier rise.

stocks:C.standing: The New York-based bank with the widest overseas reach of America's largest lenders. Its treasury and trade arm moves cash for multinationals across dozens of countries, so its shares respond to global trade and interest rates.

stocks:SPCX.standing: The rocket and satellite company Elon Musk founded. It flies most of the world's orbital launches and runs Starlink, the largest satellite internet network, and its military Starshield variant makes it a defence contractor too.
stocks:SPCX.recent: The trough came as SpaceX's default risk hit a fresh peak in a tech-led selloff. Since then it has announced $74 billion in AI computing campuses, caught a Starship upper stage after 14 orbits, and faced a European Commission demand to lift Starshield limits that cut off Ukraine's drones above 161 km/h.

stocks:9984.T.standing: SoftBank Group is the Tokyo-listed holding company Masayoshi Son built. Its value rests mainly on stakes in other companies, chiefly the chip designer Arm and its bets on AI, so its share price moves with the price of AI.
stocks:9984.T.recent: Over the fortnight SoftBank signed Sceye to fly stratospheric cell towers over Japan. Then, after the low, it booked more than $3 billion in losses on turbine deposits meant for AI power from natural gas. Neither event explains the fall in the share.

stocks:WHL.JO.standing: A Johannesburg-listed retailer that runs the Woolworths stores in South Africa, selling premium food, clothing and homeware, plus Country Road Group in Australia. Its food arm is a gauge of what the middle class still spends.
stocks:WHL.JO.recent: Woolworths reported that turnover at Woolworths Foods grew only 1.9% and concession sales just 0.1%. That is a sharp slowdown in the food business the group relies on to sell to South Africa's middle class, and the shares fell on the figures.

wiki-jensen-huang.standing: Co-founder of Nvidia, the chipmaker whose graphics processors became the hardware most AI models are trained on. He led it from its founding in 1993, and its rise made him one of the most closely watched executives in technology.
wiki-jensen-huang.recent: Nvidia's board opened an investigation into Huang's affair with Alice Huang, whose employer Megaspeed reportedly bought $4.8bn of Nvidia equipment, and Sen. Cramer called for a resignation. Huang quit, leaving finance chief Colette Kress as interim CEO; Trump then backed a 177,000-signature petition for reinstatement.

stocks:PLTR.standing: Palantir sells software that pulls scattered records into one searchable picture, to armies, spy agencies, police forces and large companies. Government contracts are its core, so its fortunes follow public budgets and politics.
stocks:PLTR.recent: Palantir held its Q3 2026 earnings call in the window, though nothing here says what the results contained. The one story about its business came from Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, where the Left coalition rejected Palantir yet still plans automated police data analysis. Neither accounts for the price.

stocks:MBG.DE.standing: The Stuttgart carmaker behind Mercedes-Benz cars and vans, listed in Frankfurt. Its profits lean on wealthy buyers in China and on exports to the US, so Chinese demand and tariffs reach the share quickly.
stocks:MBG.DE.recent: Four months of talks in Germany ended with Mercedes-Benz halting investment in its home country, the one development here about the company's own business. It came on the last day of the window, so it does not explain the rise before it.

stocks:ISP.MI.standing: Italy's largest bank by assets, listed in Milan. It holds a large stock of Italian government bonds, so its shares move with the spread Rome pays over Germany and with any change in how the state taxes its lenders.
stocks:ISP.MI.recent: Intesa publicly attacked the bank levies in Italy's 2027 budget, which seeks €5.9 billion from the country's banks next year, and said the ECB may intervene. That dispute surfaced after the latest reading, so it does not explain the share's path over the window.

stocks:TSLA.standing: The Austin-based maker of electric cars and of batteries that store grid power, run by Elon Musk. Its share price carries bets on driverless taxis and robots worth far more than its car sales earn.
stocks:TSLA.recent: Tesla ended Cybertruck production after selling 11,586 in nine months, by Cox Automotive's estimate. The shares rose 4% that morning as investors bet that the steering-wheel-free Cybercab replaces it. Bloomberg has since reported that SpaceX and Tesla may announce a merger in December.

poly-us-strike-on-cuba-by-december-31.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States carries out a military strike on Cuba before its deadline. Its price is what traders stake on open conflict between Washington and Havana, 90 miles apart across the Florida Straits.

poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Reserve Bank of India leaves its repo rate, the rate at which it lends to commercial banks, unchanged at its December meeting. That rate sets the cost of borrowing across India.
poly-will-the-reserve-bank-of-india-make.recent: This fortnight's rates news came from Washington. A hot October inflation print had the Fed's Logan calling for two more hikes, and the stronger dollar pushed the Indonesian rupiah to a record low. The rupee and the RBI's rate path were flagged as exposed, but nothing reported about the RBI itself explains the shift in bets.

stocks:BABA.standing: The Hangzhou group behind Taobao and Tmall, China's biggest online marketplaces, and the country's largest cloud computing business. These New York-listed shares trade on Chinese consumer spending and its bets on artificial intelligence.
stocks:BABA.recent: The fortnight's news from Alibaba was of expansion, not setback: its Qwen model became the AI behind Siri on Chinese iPhones, it said it would list its T-Head chip unit in Hong Kong while keeping control, and it launched an AI music app. None of it accounts for the fall in the share price.

poly-will-anthropics-market-cap-be-less-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, closes its first day of public trading worth less than $1.25 trillion. It is a wager on how the market will price one of the largest AI developers.

poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if International Atomic Energy Agency inspectors visit an Iranian nuclear site by the year's end. Those inspections are the only outside check on how much enriched uranium Iran holds.
poly-iaea-visits-isfahan-fordow-or-natan.recent: Iran's Assembly of Experts urged leaving the nuclear treaty; a day later the UN watchdog called on Iran to reopen its facilities to inspection, and the UN remained unable to inspect sites struck in the US-Israeli attacks. Washington, meanwhile, offered up to $20 million to informants on Iran's nuclear program.

stocks:1024.HK.standing: Kuaishou runs China's second-largest short-video and live-streaming app after ByteDance's Douyin, and earns from advertising, live-stream tipping and e-commerce. Its shares follow Chinese ad spending and its contest with Douyin.
stocks:1024.HK.recent: Kuaishou's AI video unit Kling raised about 19.8 billion yuan in a round that valued it above its parent. Nothing reported in the window ties that deal to the fall in the shares.

poly-will-marco-rubio-win-the-2028-repub.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Marco Rubio, the former Florida senator who became Trump's secretary of state, is the Republican presidential nominee in 2028. It prices him against the field to succeed Trump.

stocks:300750.SZ.standing: The world's largest maker of electric-vehicle batteries, based in Ningde, Fujian, and listed in Shenzhen. Its cells go into cars from Tesla to BMW, so its share moves on Chinese EV sales, lithium prices and Western trade rules.

poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Russia and Ukraine agree a peace deal before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, so it moves on talks, battlefield turns and Washington's diplomacy.
poly-ukraine-signs-peace-deal-with-russi.recent: Trump met Putin envoy Kirill Dmitriev at the White House and promised a 'big, beautiful agreement', but the first Russia and Ukraine talks in 9 months, in Abu Dhabi, ended without a breakthrough. Zelensky then said the US had raised a Donbas withdrawal in exchange for NATO, and Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge inside a record Russian-reported drone barrage.

poly-will-chiang-wan-an-win-the-next-tai.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Chiang Wan-an, the Kuomintang mayor of Taipei, wins the city's next mayoral race. Taiwan's capital has twice sent its mayor on to the presidency, so the seat is read as a test of the parties' national strength.

poly-will-no-listed-leader-be-out-before.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out only if every national leader on the market's list is still in office when 2027 begins. Its price is what traders will pay on incumbents outlasting elections, coups, resignations and deaths.

poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the United States and Iran reach an effective ceasefire before its deadline. Its price is what traders will pay to bet on a truce, not a forecast of one.
poly-us-x-iran-effective-ceasefire-by-no.recent: The rise followed talks in Islamabad, where Iran shortened its plan to reopen Hormuz from 7 days to 2, and came after Trump held fire over the mines in the strait. Pulling the other way: Iran says mines hit 4 tankers in 24 hours, and 3 US carriers and 13 destroyers now face Iran.

stocks:UPS.standing: United Parcel Service, the Atlanta-based carrier that moves parcels by truck and by its own cargo airline, hubbed at Louisville. Its volumes track consumer spending and online shopping, and its costs track fuel and labour contracts.

stocks:HMC.standing: Honda's American depositary shares on the New York Stock Exchange, priced in dollars. The Tokyo company is the world's largest motorcycle maker and a major carmaker, so the yen and US tariffs on Japanese cars both reach this price.
stocks:HMC.recent: Honda reported profit up 66%, carried by its motorcycles while its car business still lost money. That result landed after the chart's last close, so it does not account for the move within it.

poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the first lawmaker Israel's president asks to form a government after the 2026 vote succeeds, so that no second candidate is handed the mandate. Each failed round brings Israel closer to another election.
poly-will-no-second-mandate-to-form-a-go.recent: 67 lawmakers recommended Eisenkot to form a government against 46 for Netanyahu, yet a second mandate drew more money once Eisenkot opened unity talks with the man he says must go. The same days brought election-day arrests of 3 Arab-party members on unfounded information, which the opposition called a coup.

stocks:COL.AX.standing: Coles Group runs one of Australia's two dominant supermarket chains, alongside Woolworths, plus liquor stores such as Liquorland. Its shares trade on food inflation, wage costs and regulators' scrutiny of grocery pricing.
stocks:COL.AX.recent: The one story about Coles was its disclosure of a cyber attack, made without saying what happened. That disclosure came after this window closed, so it does not account for the slide.

poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether the Federal Reserve leaves its policy rate unchanged at its January 2027 meeting. Its price is what traders will pay for a pause, set against a hike or a cut.
poly-will-there-be-no-change-in-fed-inte.recent: Hotter October inflation, with consumer prices up 0.4%, brought the Fed's Logan out calling for two more hikes and sent two-year Treasury yields up 18 basis points. Deutsche Bank now sees three straight hikes to 4.625% by early 2027, and Kansas City Fed president Schmid says the Fed has more work to do.

stocks:WOW.AX.standing: Australia's largest supermarket chain, which also owns the Big W discount stores and the New Zealand Countdown grocery network. Its prices and margins sit at the centre of the country's long-running argument over the cost of food.

stocks:000660.KS.standing: South Korea's second-largest memory-chip maker after Samsung, and the leading supplier of the high-bandwidth memory stacked beside Nvidia's AI processors. Its share price is a read on how much the AI build-out is spending.
stocks:000660.KS.recent: The fortnight's news on SK Hynix was about building: crews working 24/7 on its first fab at Yongin, a plant set to stand 150 metres tall, and a $1 billion fund with a testing hub for smaller Korean chip suppliers. None of it explains the fall in the share.

stocks:AMZN.standing: The world's largest online retailer and, through Amazon Web Services, the biggest seller of cloud computing. AWS earns most of the company's operating profit, so the share moves on cloud demand as much as on shopping.
stocks:AMZN.recent: Nothing reported over these weeks explains the rise. The blow to Amazon's own business came after the last close shown: a United Launch Alliance Vulcan failed 10 minutes after liftoff from Cape Canaveral and destroyed 40 Amazon Leo satellites. The constellation, its answer to Starlink, depends on scarce non-SpaceX launches and faces an FCC deployment deadline.

stocks:DBK.DE.standing: Shares of Germany's largest lender, listed in Frankfurt and run with a large investment-banking arm. The price tracks European interest rates, trading income and the bank's legal and credit costs.

poly-will-christine-lagarde-win-the-2027.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Christine Lagarde, the former French finance minister who now heads the European Central Bank, wins France's 2027 presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome.

stocks:CBK.DE.standing: Germany's second-largest listed bank, based in Frankfurt and a main lender to the Mittelstand, the mid-sized firms behind German exports. The German state has held a stake in it since rescuing it in the 2008 crisis.
stocks:CBK.DE.recent: UniCredit's €45 billion bid for the bank won unconditional EU approval, after the US Fed had also approved. Competition chief Teresa Ribera warned that Brussels will intervene if Berlin tries to block it. It is the first big cross-border bank merger the EU's banking union was built to allow.

poly-will-anthropics-valuation-hit-high-.standing: A Polymarket contract on whether Anthropic, the AI lab behind Claude, is valued at $1.75 trillion or more by year's end. Funding rounds and share sales set that valuation, so the price moves on news of either.

stocks:JPM.standing: America's largest bank by assets, joining the Chase consumer bank to one of Wall Street's biggest investment banks. Its shares are read as a gauge of US credit, consumer spending and dealmaking.
stocks:JPM.recent: On Monday nearly 5,000 Chase customers reported being locked out, by Downdetector's count, as access problems hit other major US banks the same day. JPMorgan also linked its blockchain deposit network with DBS for 24/7 dollar transfers. Neither accounts for the share's path over these three weeks.

poly-variational-fdv-above-2b-one-day-af.standing: A bet on whether Variational, a crypto derivatives trading protocol, is valued above $2 billion fully diluted the day after its token launches. Fully diluted valuation prices every token that will ever exist, not only those trading.
poly-variational-fdv-above-2b-one-day-af.recent: Nothing in the fortnight's news concerned Variational or the timing of its token launch. The prediction-market stories were about Polymarket itself: Trump Jr. left Kalshi after his firm put $300 million into its rival. That explains nothing about these bets.

poly-will-jensen-huang-rejoin-nvidia-by-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Jensen Huang, who co-founded NVIDIA and ran it as chief executive for three decades, returns to the company before the end of 2026. Its price is what traders pay for a yes.

poly-predictfun-fdv-above-2b-one-day-aft.standing: A bet on whether the token of Predict.fun, a crypto prediction-market platform, is valued above $2 billion the day after it lists, counting every token that will ever exist rather than only those trading.

poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-2028-us-.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if the Democratic nominee wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders will stake on that outcome, and it reprices as each party's fortunes shift.
poly-will-the-democrats-win-the-2028-us-.recent: Democrats won the midterms in a blowout that broke MAGA, and the biggest shock was in Mississippi, where rallying the Black vote decided the race. JD Vance blamed the Iran war for Trump's crushing defeat and clashed with him over it, and Trump made Defense Secretary Hegseth pay for the debacle.

wiki-israel.standing: How many people read Wikipedia's article on Israel each day. It rises when a war, an election or a break with an ally sends readers who do not follow the region looking for the country itself.
wiki-israel.recent: Trump announced an end to the $4 billion in annual US aid to Israel after 2026, and Eisenkot said the cut showed Netanyahu must be replaced. 67 of 120 Knesset members then recommended Eisenkot for prime minister. He is now negotiating a unity government with the man he says must go, while Netanyahu presses Trump to resume striking Iran.

wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.standing: Benjamin Netanyahu, leader of the right-wing Likud party and Israel's longest-serving prime minister, who has dominated the country's politics since first taking office in 1996.
wiki-benjamin-netanyahu.recent: After the vote, 67 Knesset members recommended Eisenkot for prime minister against 46 for Netanyahu, with the Joint List's 19 seats behind Eisenkot, and Herzog opened coalition talks. Netanyahu stays on as caretaker in command of the security services, and is pressing Eisenkot to join a unity government.

poly-will-pete-buttigieg-win-the-2028-de.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Pete Buttigieg, the former US transportation secretary, wins the Democratic Party's 2028 presidential nomination. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome.

poly-will-predictfun-launch-a-token-by-n.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Predict.fun, a crypto prediction-market platform, launches its own token by Nov 30, 2026. Its price is what traders will pay for that outcome, and it trades on airdrop and launch rumours.
poly-will-predictfun-launch-a-token-by-n.recent: The fortnight's prediction-market news was about Trump Jr. leaving Kalshi after his firm invested $300 million in Polymarket, a rival. None of it concerned Predict.fun or a token, so nothing here accounts for the fall in this contract's price.

poly-will-ron-desantis-win-the-2028-us-p.standing: A Polymarket contract that pays out if Ron DeSantis, the Republican elected Florida's governor in 2018, wins the 2028 US presidential election. Its price is what traders pay for that outcome.
poly-will-ron-desantis-win-the-2028-us-p.recent: The fortnight's news was Trump's crushing midterm defeat, which JD Vance blamed on the Iran war before clashing with Trump in public. None of it mentions DeSantis, and none of it accounts for the bet on him.

stocks:AVIO.MI.standing: Avio builds Europe's Vega small-satellite rockets and the solid-fuel boosters that lift Ariane 6, from its works at Colleferro near Rome. It is the continent's main alternative to buying launches from SpaceX.
stocks:AVIO.MI.recent: Early in the month Avio scaled back a demonstrator programme over technical challenges. Then ICEYE bid €41 a share, a 21.3% premium and €2.05 billion in all, and pledged €1 billion more of investment in Italy. The Finnish radar-satellite operator wants its own launcher, and the Italian state, which holds a stake in Avio, has a golden-power veto over the sale.
